- The net Q2 shortfall is −1,390 TEU in 2023 and −3,518.5 in 2024, for −4,908.5 combined.
- Ivelholm (−1,997.5), Fennick (−1,703) and Brackwater (−1,164) together come to −4,864.5.
- Five other ports have smaller shortfalls, between −417.5 and −30.5.
- Cindervale (+827) and Aldermouth (+489.5) shipped more in Q2 than their Q1–Q3 average.

There was no live marimo session, so I edited the file directly. Please open the notebook and tell me whether the view supports or rejects the hypothesis. I'll add your verdict to the facts cell in your own words.

@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ## Hypothesis: a few ports cause the Q2 dip

    A few ports cause most of the second-quarter dip in shipments.
    For each port and year, the Q2 shortfall is Q2 TEU minus the mean of Q1 and Q3 TEU.

    **Outcome:** three ports hold more than half of the total Q2 shortfall (2023 and 2024 combined).
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def q2_shortfall_by_port(mo, pl, shipments):
    import altair as alt

    _quarterly = (
        shipments
        .with_columns(
            year=pl.col('ship_date').dt.year(),
            quarter=pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter(),
        )
        .filter(pl.col('quarter').is_in([1, 2, 3]))
        .group_by('port', 'year')
        .agg(
            q1=pl.col('teu').filter(pl.col('quarter').eq(1)).sum(),
            q2=pl.col('teu').filter(pl.col('quarter').eq(2)).sum(),
            q3=pl.col('teu').filter(pl.col('quarter').eq(3)).sum(),
        )
        .with_columns(
            shortfall=pl.col('q2').sub(pl.col('q1').add(pl.col('q3')).truediv(2)),
            year=pl.col('year').cast(pl.String),
        )
        .collect()
    )

    _chart = (
        alt.Chart(_quarterly)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X('port:N', sort=alt.EncodingSortField('shortfall', op='sum'), title='Port'),
            y=alt.Y('shortfall:Q', title='Q2 TEU minus mean of Q1 and Q3'),
            color=alt.Color('year:N', title='Year'),
            xOffset='year:N',
            tooltip=['port', 'year', 'q1', 'q2', 'q3', alt.Tooltip('shortfall:Q', format='.0f')],
        )
        .properties(width='container', height=320)
    )
    q2_shortfall_by_port = mo.ui.altair_chart(_chart)
    q2_shortfall_by_port
    return (q2_shortfall_by_port,)


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    ### Facts

    - Total TEU by quarter: 2023 Q1 14,050, Q2 13,036, Q3 14,802; 2024 Q1 12,991, Q2 9,622, Q3 13,290.
    - Net Q2 shortfall across all ports: −1,390 TEU in 2023 and −3,519 TEU in 2024, so −4,909 combined.
    - Combined shortfall by port: Ivelholm −1,998, Fennick −1,703, Brackwater −1,164, Hollowmere −414, Emberly Quay −255, Glassford −244.
    - Four ports have a Q2 surplus instead: Cindervale +827, Aldermouth +490, Dovesend −31 (about flat), Juniper Reach −418.
    - Ivelholm, Fennick and Brackwater together come to −4,865 TEU. The gross shortfall across ports with negative values is −6,227 TEU.
    """)
    return
